title: Sunny and the Platypus
author: Jamie Wigg
the_end_text:
The End.
Sweet dreams, little one. Goodnight.
back_cover_blurb: When the sky turns soft and blue, little Sunny the quokka wanders down to a quiet creek and meets a gentle brown platypus paddling in the moonlit water. Together they watch the ripples shimmer, the stars come out, and the whole creek settle in for the night. A calm, cosy bedtime tale for winding down and drifting off to sleep. Perfect for little ones ages 1-5.

pages.scene: Little Sunny the quokka pads softly along a grassy path in the soft blue evening, tall gum trees rising around her, the first honey-gold stars appearing in a deep plum-navy sky, a few sleepy fireflies drifting near.
pages.text: The evening was soft and blue, and Sunny the little quokka walked slowly down to the quiet creek. Everything felt hushed and cosy, as if the whole world was getting ready for bed.

pages.scene: Sunny reaches the edge of a calm creek among gum trees, the still water glowing with warm honey-gold reflections and a rising moon, fireflies twinkling above the reeds.
pages.text: At the end of the path, the creek lay still and shining. The water was smooth as a soft blanket, holding the moon and the stars upon it.

pages.scene: Sunny sits on the mossy bank looking at gentle rings of ripples spreading across the moonlit water, reflections wobbling in honey-gold and deep plum-navy, fireflies glowing softly.
pages.text: Then Sunny noticed little ripples, spreading in slow, gentle circles across the water. “Who is out there?” she whispered kindly.

pages.scene: A soft brown furry platypus with a duck-like bill surfaces smoothly and quietly in the calm creek, tiny sparkling droplets rolling off its fur, moonlit ripples fanning out gently, Sunny watching from the bank.
pages.text: Up from the water rose a soft brown platypus, gentle and quiet, with a smooth little bill and kind sleepy eyes. It hardly made a sound at all.

pages.scene: Sunny leans forward warmly on the mossy bank to greet the platypus floating calmly nearby, both bathed in warm honey-gold moonlight, stars reflected on the still water between them.
pages.text: “Hello,” said Sunny softly. “Good evening, little one,” the platypus answered, in a voice as calm as the ripples.

pages.scene: The platypus paddles slowly and peacefully in a circle using its webbed feet, leaving a silver trail on the moonlit creek, Sunny watching happily from the grassy bank among gum trees and fireflies.
pages.text: “Let me show you my quiet water world,” said the platypus. It paddled in slow, gentle circles with its little webbed feet.

pages.scene: Close view of the platypus's webbed feet pushing softly through glassy moonlit water, warm golden ripples curling out, reeds swaying slowly, deep plum-navy sky above.
pages.text: Round and round it drifted, smooth and unhurried, its webbed feet stirring the softest of ripples. The water rocked gently, like a cradle.

pages.scene: The platypus dives beneath the surface in a smooth quiet arc, its brown back curving gracefully, only a small silver splash and widening rings left behind on the moonlit creek, Sunny watching wide-eyed and calm.
pages.text: Then the platypus dipped its head and dived, so smoothly and quietly it barely made a splash. Down it went into the cool, dark, cosy water.

pages.scene: Underwater dreamy view of the platypus gliding slowly through soft moonlit water, gentle beams of golden light drifting down, tiny bubbles rising, everything hushed and peaceful.
pages.text: Beneath the surface it glided along, calm and slow, where the water was quiet and still. Little silver bubbles floated up like tiny sleepy stars.

pages.scene: The platypus rises gently back to the surface near Sunny, water shimmering off its soft fur in honey-gold droplets, moonlight and stars mirrored on the calm creek, fireflies drifting.
pages.text: Up it came again, soft and gentle, with a happy little sigh. “How peaceful it is down there,” it said with a yawn.

pages.scene: The platypus paddles toward a cosy burrow tucked into the mossy riverbank, warm golden glow at the burrow's round entrance, soft grasses draped over it, moonlit water lapping gently below.
pages.text: “This is my home,” said the platypus, paddling to a cosy burrow in the soft riverbank. It was warm and round and snug, tucked safely into the earth.

pages.scene: Sunny peeks warmly at the cosy riverbank burrow lined with soft dry leaves and grasses, a gentle golden glow inside, the platypus resting at the entrance, stars twinkling in the deep plum-navy sky above the creek.
pages.text: Inside it was lined with soft dry leaves, just right for sleeping. “What a cosy little home,” Sunny whispered warmly.

pages.scene: Sunny and the platypus sit side by side at the water's edge, gazing at the big round honey-gold moon reflected perfectly on the glassy still creek, fireflies and stars all around them.
pages.text: Side by side they sat by the water, gazing at the moon. There it was again, floating on the creek, round and golden and calm.

pages.scene: A wide peaceful view of countless stars reflected in the mirror-still creek, so the water and sky seem to blend together, Sunny and the platypus tiny and cosy on the bank among glowing fireflies.
pages.text: Above them the stars came out, one by one, soft and bright. And every single star shone again in the quiet water below.

pages.scene: Sunny gives a big cosy yawn beside the platypus on the mossy bank, both looking sleepy and content, warm honey-gold moonlight glowing on the still water, gentle ripples fading.
pages.text: Sunny gave a big, slow yawn, and the platypus yawned too. The gentle rocking water was making them both feel wonderfully sleepy.

pages.scene: The platypus rests its bill drowsily near the burrow at the water's edge, eyelids heavy and content, soft reflections shimmering, fireflies glowing dim and warm in the deep plum-navy night.
pages.text: “It is time for me to sleep,” the platypus murmured softly. “Thank you for showing me your beautiful water,” said Sunny.

pages.scene: Sunny waves a gentle goodnight to the platypus as it settles cosily at the entrance of its riverbank burrow, moonlit creek calm and glowing, stars reflected on the still surface.
pages.text: “Goodnight, dear platypus,” Sunny said gently. “Goodnight, little quokka. Sleep well,” the platypus whispered, snuggling into its cosy burrow.

pages.scene: Sunny pads slowly home through soft moonlit grass among the gum trees, fireflies lighting the way, the calm silver creek glowing behind her under a starry plum-navy sky.
pages.text: So Sunny padded home through the soft, moonlit grass, warm and happy inside. The fireflies drifted along beside her, lighting the gentle way.

pages.scene: Sunny curls up cosy and snug in her soft leafy nest under the gum trees, eyes gently closing, warm honey-gold moonlight and a few fireflies glowing around her, the starry sky above.
pages.text: At home, Sunny curled up snug and cosy in her soft little nest. Her eyes grew heavy, and the whole world felt calm and safe.

pages.scene: Sunny sleeps peacefully with a soft smile, a dreamy glow above her showing the gentle platypus swimming among shining stars on rippling water, everything bathed in warm honey-gold and deep plum-navy.
pages.text: And as she drifted off to sleep, Sunny dreamed of the gentle platypus, swimming softly on the shining, starry water. Goodnight, Sunny. Goodnight.
